newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund inflows rise -- survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund inflows rise -- survey.

text.p: U.S. stock fund inflows for the industry rose to an estimated $1.57 billion for the three days ended April 10 compared with $910 million for the two days ended April 7, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracking firm said the biggest jump was in growth and income funds, which sharply increased to inflows of $1.13 billion from $7 million for the previous period.
Growth funds increased to inflows $424 million from $346 million, while aggressive growth funds dropped sharply to inflows of $4 million from $642 million.

Industry wide, bond funds reversed to inflows of $338 million from outflows of $395 million. Muni funds turned around to inflows of $281 million from outflows of $181 million, and flexible/balanced/mixed funds had inflows of $160 million versus outflows of $60 million.
